svg.title: LEONARD E. MOORE — latest RSS headlines

g.text: After the midterms, things are looking rocky for Elon Musk and data centers ◆ Megaspeed exec was recruited to spy on Nvidia CEO, according to US intelligence memo ◆ Parents want safer phones for kids. These companies are answering the call. ◆ Binance CFO is leaving to ‘pursue a new venture’ after $6.3 billion hack ◆ Amazon’s new basic Kindle proves you don’t need all the bells and whistles ◆ Sequoia shutting down its Scouts program marks the end of an era ◆
